outcome: Proportion of women with histopathologically confirmed RPOC
Reliability of ultrasound in diagnosing RPOC
Maternal complications (fever, abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, hysterectomy, smooth muscle in histopathology, significant bleeding during surgery)
cohort: 151 women who delivered and had postpartum evacuation at a tertiary teaching hospital in Oman over 11 years.
finding: Diagnosis of RPOC after postpartum evacuation is challenging, with pelvic ultrasound showing high sensitivity but low specificity compared to histopathology.
